summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Notice of Annual General and Special Meeting, Management Information Circular, and proxy materials for a meeting scheduled September 25, 2026. The agenda includes routine items: receiving audited financials, electing directors, reappointing Deloitte LLP as auditor, approving an amendment to the company's articles, and approving an amended share-based compensation plan. Record date is August 12, 2026. This is an ordinary meeting notice with no special-situation event; the filing is routine and non-material, mapping to a standard proxy circular for a Canadian issuer.
